title: Architecture: Katalyst Hanas Data Platform (Internship)
description: Enterprise Lakehouse architecture for banking client during 2-month internship: Apache NiFi ingestion from multi-source (DB, Excel, Oracle), Apache Iceberg tables on MinIO, Dremio query engine, Star Schema with SCD Type 2 dimensions.

nodes.label: Core Banking Database
nodes.description: Customer data (individual + corporate) with raw staging tables

nodes.label: Excel Files
nodes.description: Account and branch data in Excel format

nodes.label: Oracle Source
nodes.description: Relational tables and XML data from Oracle database

nodes.label: Apache NiFi
nodes.description: Visual dataflow pipelines for each source type with processor chains and provenance tracking

nodes.label: MinIO Object Storage
nodes.description: S3-compatible storage for Iceberg table data files

nodes.label: Apache Iceberg Tables
nodes.description: Open table format with snapshot isolation, schema evolution, time travel for audit

nodes.label: Star Schema
nodes.description: Fact Account (6 cols) + Dim Customer (24 cols) + Dim Branch (15 cols) + Dim Account (14 cols)

nodes.label: SCD Type 2 Logic
nodes.description: EFFECTIVE_FROM, EFFECTIVE_TO, IS_CURRENT with row_hash change detection for 19 Customer attributes

nodes.label: Dremio
nodes.description: Semantic layer and SQL query engine over Iceberg Tables with spaces/datasets/views

nodes.label: Audit Metadata
nodes.description: RECORD_SOURCE, SRC_SCN, LOAD_TIMESTAMP columns for lineage and audit
